column1: # tests/doom-core/lanes.tsv — every suite in tests/doom-core, and how it is run.
# Decision 0008 task 9: "the runner enumerates ... lanes. Each lane reports
# checked, pass, fail and executed/unmeasured counts." This is the enumeration,
# and tests/doom-core/run.sh reads it. THE FIRST THING THAT RUNNER CHECKS IS
# THIS FILE AGAINST THE DIRECTORY, in both directions: a suite on disk with no
# row here is a lane nobody runs, and a row here with no file is a lane nobody
# can run. Which suites exist was maintained by memory until 2026-09-18, and
# three drifts found by one sweep that day -- a table missing eleven units, an
# entry list missing two contracts, an orphan variable nothing reached on this
#            under:NAME            run by that suite, not again by run.sh
#            subject:NAME          run by that suite against copied trees
#   summary  how the lane reports: `checked:LABEL` for a
#            "LABEL: N checked, N pass, N fail" line, `executed:LABEL` for
#            "LABEL: N passed, N failed" line. THE LABEL IS NOT ALWAYS THE FILE
#   needs    what must be in the environment for the lane to check everything
#            it has: environment variable names, `A|B` for either of two, and
#            `kernel:--option` for a capability the kernel must have. `-` for a
#            lane that needs nothing. tests/doom-core/run.sh reads this column
#            BEFORE IT RUNS ANYTHING and names what is missing, with the lanes
#            it affects -- because on 2026-09-18 a four-hour gate ended red on
#            two absences that were knowable at second zero: HARNESS_ONE_CLOSURE
#            for screens (one of six directories build-artifacts.sh writes) and
#            a kernel too old for loop-reports. A FULLY GREEN REQUIRE_ALL RUN IS
#            NOT REACHABLE FROM THE DOCUMENTED SETUP ALONE: docs/building.md
#            names two of the compiler variables and none of the harness ones.
#   note     what the lane is for, and what it needs to do more than skip
